population.inclusion_rule: MEASUREMENT CORPUS = data/mt5/XAUUSD_M15.csv ONLY (47275 bars, sha256 4d73f5cebe33ec91c5312340337eb62c2cf1f49060c91c42761bf631b26aba56). Outcome surface = results/clean_labels/XAUUSD/20260723T083443Z/clean_labels (TN_ENV_CLEAN_L2). One unit = one (decision_ts, side) row with finite y_mfe_r and trend_bias in {+1,-1}. SUCCESS GATE uses HOLDOUT units only (decision_ts >= 2025-12-24 19:15:00, corpus index 37820).
population.exclusion_rule: F-086 236-bar stride holdout is NOT this split and remains unspent. features.point_in_time_rule: trend_bias (FM-054) is the stored t=0 ternary on the bar. y_mfe_r and y_time_to_mfe use path labels after t, which is the object (information in the subsequent path of a given side), not a t=0 tradable size knob. F-051 centered-swing in stored features is declared: PRIMARY uses only FM-054 sign. F-066 session/hour are OUT OF PATH for the gate.

labels.y_definition: Arm S: y = clean_labels y_mfe_r on that (decision_ts, side) row (TN_ENV_CLEAN_L2 horizon_excursion, exit-agnostic, max_forward=40). Arm T: y = y_time_to_mfe on that row (bars until primary-path MFE first attained; nulls dropped). NOT stream mfe, NOT y_tp1, NOT y_R_net, NOT SEM-027 ΔMFE.
labels.sign_convention: Positive contrast_S means the agreeing side printed more MFE than the disagreeing side. Positive contrast_T means the agreeing side took more bars to print its MFE.

components.name: not_a_trade
components.bps_or_formula: y_mfe_r is not book PnL. No spread, commission, or slippage is applied. SEM-015 is OUT OF PATH. A later size overlay on y_R_net is a different MC-*.

exits.intrabar_rule: Inherited from the sealed clean_labels protocol (horizon_excursion, exit-agnostic). This experiment does not re-walk SL/TP. It does not use opportunities.outcome.
not_equal_to: forward_walk net R as this y

splits.embargo: 96 M15 bars between last train timestamp and first holdout timestamp
splits.purge: drop train rows whose 40-bar horizon overlaps holdout start
splits.oos_fraction_or_dates: last 20% of corpus bars by index; first holdout timestamp 2025-12-24 19:15:00 (idx 37820). Identical calendar to MC-ASYM-XAUUSD-M15-V1. F-086 stride holdout of 236 bars is a different split and is not spent.

metrics.success_gate: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, PER ARM. Arm S and Arm T are pre-registered together and scored independently. For each arm: holdout both agree/disagree cells n>=30 AND sign(holdout contrast)==sign(train contrast). Meeting a clause is NOT economic validation while economic_claims_allowed is false. Overlay k=0.5 is reported, never gated. Session and hour cells are never gated. Passing S does not pass T.
metrics.kill_criteria: Any outcome including n=0 or n<30 is registered. Changing y (to y_R_net, stream mfe, or SEM-027 ΔMFE), agree definition, overlay k into PRIMARY, holdout date, embargo, or purge after seeing holdout y requires a NEW MC-* id. Do not promote session/hour into PRIMARY after seeing them. Do not turn this into a side picker.

pipeline_identity.config_version_source: NOT the production config path. Object frozen in docs/research/magnitude_prior_object.md. ACTIVE_VERSION is never written.
